review_notes: I read the whole file. It contains only theorems and declares no simp lemmas, no simp-set attributes and no new definitions. Its simp calls are `simpa [hA.module_smul] using H.nsmul_mem hx n` and `simpa using hx`. In PadicPow.lean, line 466 marks `module_smul` with `@[simp]`, so the explicit `hA.module_smul` argument is redundant. That is a style point, not a defect in the simp interface. I found no missing canonical simp lemma, no wrongly oriented rewrite, no competing rules and no credible loop. The file's main statements are iff statements with `letI` module instances. Marking them simp would be unjustified, because their instance arguments and hypotheses make them poor simp lemmas. I did not run Lean, so I can't say how the simplifier behaves on the Additive/Multiplicative preimage goals.
